runtime_change.message: fix(editor): reject stale account preference writes
summary: Account workspace and favorite-palette preferences carry independent revisions.
Changed fields use an atomic SQLite JSON1 UPSERT compare-and-swap; stale values return 409 with normalized current state, and missing revisions return 428.
The Editor updates its revision after successful Save and preserves local edits while surfacing conflicts; it does not silently retry the conflicting field.
No database schema migration was introduced; Save and Publish remain separate operations.
